TV_REMOTE_INTRO: Use the arrows to move through this help. Playback and color buttons act in the player when the corresponding action is available.
TV_REMOTE_NAVIGATE: Move focus between controls and scroll through lists.
TV_REMOTE_SELECT: Activate the focused control. In the player, select Play/Pause to control playback.
TV_REMOTE_GO_BACK: Close the top menu or dialog, cancel seeking, or return to the previous screen. On Home, return to the TV launcher.
TV_REMOTE_SEEK: Seek using left/right when no player control or menu is focused; otherwise use the seek bar. Fast-forward and rewind buttons also seek.
TV_REMOTE_PLAY: Play / pause (if your remote has these buttons).
TV_REMOTE_OPTIONAL: No color or media buttons? Use the player controls with arrows and OK. Use the TV remote for volume. Search, navigation and this help are also available on screen; keyboard shortcuts are optional.
TV_STREAMING_GUIDE: Torrents need a streaming server on another device. In Streaming settings, add its HTTP(S) address (for example http://192.168.1.10:11470), select it and check that it is online. Keep that device running. Direct HTTP videos do not require a server.
TV_PLAYER_CODEC_ERROR: This TV cannot decode this video or audio format. Try another stream or enable transcoding on your remote server.
TV_PLAYER_NETWORK_ERROR: Check the TV connection and the remote streaming server, then try again.
TV_PLAYER_SUBTITLE_ERROR: Subtitles could not be loaded. Try an SRT or VTT track.
TV_PLAYER_ASS_NOTICE: ASS/SSA styling is unavailable on this TV. Plain text conversion is used when possible; use SRT or VTT if it fails.
TV_STREAMING_WARNING: Torrents need a streaming server on another device. Configure its address in Streaming settings.
